title: CAI Content Credentials is affected by an Improper Input Validation vulnerability that could result… (CVE-2026-113573)
description: CAI Content Credentials suffers from an improper input validation vulnerability that can allow an attacker to bypass security features and gain unauthorized write access without requiring user interaction. Exploitation depends on conditions beyond the attacker's control. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 5.9.
